title: Made this game about 6 times now, it's finally taking form!
author: Sheru7000
selftext:
I have had the idea of this game for years now, and have failed to make it so many times, but now finally, I am getting somewhat closer to the original vision! And I am so glad! Opus 5.5 has been a delight!  
If you try it [https://counterstance.vercel.app/](https://counterstance.vercel.app/)  
PLEASE hit me up, I'd love to hear all about it!  
It's still very much a work in progress and barely out of prototyping phase, but am very happy with what I got so far!

Trailer shot and edited by Claude as well (took waaay too long this time, had a lot of games to capture and it kept focusing in all the wrong things when recording shots).
